column3: “every leper” renders “everyone with tsara’at,” and “a dead person” renders “a soul (nefesh).”
“mankind” renders “adam,” and “acting unfaithfully” renders “acting an unfaithfulness (ma’al).”
“in full” renders “in its sum (head),” and “his wrong” renders “his guilt (asham)” (also in verse 8).
“the holy gifts” renders “the holy things” (also in verse 10).
“any man’s wife” renders “a man, a man … his wife,” and “goes astray” renders “turns aside.”
“has intercourse with her” renders “lies with her a laying of seed,” and NASB supplies “in the act.”
“jealousy” renders the plural “jealousies” (also in verses 18, 25 and 29).
“let the hair of the woman’s head go loose” renders “let loose the woman’s head,” and “the water of bitterness” renders “the waters of the bitter things” (also in verses 19 and 23–24).
“being under the authority of your husband” renders “under your husband” (also in verses 20 and 29), and “be immune” renders “be free.”
“has had intercourse with you” renders “has given his lying to you.”
NASB puts the introductory clause in parentheses; “waste away” renders “fall,” and “abdomen” renders “belly” (also in verses 22 and 27).
